reports.title: Commvault Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook for Third Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 20274 -
section: We are providing the following guidance for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027:
•Subscription revenue is expected to be between $293 million and $297 million
•Non-GAAP EBIT margin is expected to be between 20.5% and 21.0%
We are providing the following updated guidance for the full fiscal year 2027:
•Subscription revenue is expected to be between $1,127 million and $1,133 million
•Subscription ARR is expected to be between $1,205 million and $1,215 million
•Non-GAAP EBIT margin is expected to be between 21.0% and 21.5%
•Free cash flow is expected to be between $255 million and $265 million
•Diluted shares outstanding are expected to be approximately 42 million
